player_prompt.intro: Kuna da Player {player_id} a cikin Wasan Tattaunawa. Kuna da wasu albarkatu, kuma aikinku shine kasuwanci ta yadda jimlar darajar albarkatunku ta ƙaru. Abubuwan da ke da alaƙa da ƙimar da kuke da su a halin yanzu sune: + {resource_value_list} A kowane juzu'i, zaku iya magana da abokin hamayyar ku kuma kuyi tayin ciniki. Yi amfani da waɗannan alamun na musamman don ayyuka: - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources] - '[Accept]': Don karɓar tayin da ke shigowa. - '[Deny]': Don ƙin tayin da ke shigowa (tsoho). Wasan yana ɗaukar {max_turns} juzu'i gaba ɗaya.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Mai kunnawa ya yi ƙoƙarin karɓar ciniki ba tare da samun albarkatun da ake buƙata ba.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Mai kunnawa {player_id}, Aiki mara inganci. Shafi {col} ya fita daga cikin iyaka.
invalid_move.already_full: Mai kunnawa {player_id}, Aiki mara inganci. Shafi {col} ya cika.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Mai kunnawa {player_id} yayi ƙoƙarin yin tayin ciniki ba tare da samun albarkatun da suka dace ba.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya yi tayin ciniki a cikin tsarin da ba daidai ba.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Mai kunnawa {player_id} bai yi sabon tayin ciniki ba.

offers.reject: Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya ƙi tayin musayar.
offers.accept: Mai kunnawa {acceptor_id} ya yarda da tayin musayar daga Mai kunnawa {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Mai kunnawa {player_id} yayi tayin mai zuwa ga Mai kunnawa {opponent_id}: Abubuwan da aka bayar: {offered} -> Abubuwan da aka nema: {requested}

outcome.win: Mai kunnawa {winner_id} ya ci nasara ta hanyar samun riba mafi girma a cikin ƙimar kaya.
outcome.draw: Canji iri daya a darajar kaya ga dukkan 'yan wasa.
